name: fogbugz-mcp
description: Interact with FogBugz issue tracking from Claude

fogbugz_url.title: FogBugz URL
fogbugz_url.description: Base URL of your FogBugz instance, e.g. https://yourcompany.fogbugz.com

fogbugz_api_key.title: FogBugz API Token
fogbugz_api_key.description: Your personal FogBugz API token (Avatar menu > User Options > API Tokens). Cases are created and edited as the user this token belongs to, so use your own and do not share it.
